spans.s: द्रंक्षण n. A measure of weight, a tolā.
द्रढय् vt. (denom. pres. द्रढयति) 1. To fasten, to tighten, to strengthen, विशुद्धेरुत्कर्षस्त्वयि तु मम भक्तिं द्रढयति Ut.iv.; 2. to confirm, to corroborate.
द्रढिमन् m. 1. Firmness, tightness, बधान द्रागेव द्रढिमरमणीयं परिकरम् G.
; 2. heaviness; 3. affirmation, assertion.
द्रप्स n. Diluted sour milk, diluted curds. (Also द्रप्स्य.)
द्रम् vt. 1P (pres. द्रमति) To run, to run about, Bt.xiv.70.
द्रम्म m. A drachma (a word of Greek origin).
द्रव (I) a. (f. वा) 1. Running (as a horse); 2. dropping, oozing, wet, R.vii.7; 3. liquid, K.S.ii.11; 4. melted.(द्रवीभू ‘to melt,’ द्रवीभूतं प्रेम्णा तव हृदयमस्मिन्क्षण इव Ut.iii.)
द्रव (II) m. 1. Going, motion; 2. dropping, trickling; 3. flight, retreat; 4. play, amusement; 5. speed, velocity; 6. fluidity, liquefaction; 7. juice, decoction.
द्रव (I) a. (f. वा) 1. Running (as a horse); 2. dropping, oozing, wet, R.vii.7; 3. liquid, K.S.ii.11; 4. melted.(द्रवीभू ‘to melt,’ द्रवीभूतं प्रेम्णा तव हृदयमस्मिन्क्षण इव Ut.iii.)
द्राव m. 1. Flight, retreat; 2. speed; 3. running, flowing; 4. heat.
द्रव-आधार m. 1. a small vessel; 2. the hands joined and hollowed.
द्रव-ज m. treacle.
द्रव-द्रव्य n. a fluid substance.
द्रव-रसा f. lac, gum.
द्रवंती f. A river.
द्रविड m. 1. Name of a country on the east coast of the Dekkan; 2. a native of that country, विमुक्तं द्रविडपुंगवेन R.G.; 3. name of a degraded tribe. See M.x.22.
द्राविड (I) m. 1. A Drāviḍian; 2. a Brāhmaṇa of any of the five southern tribes, viz., द्राविड, कर्णाट, गुर्जर, महाराष्ट्र and तैलंग.
द्राविड (II) m. pl. The Drāviḍa country and its people.
द्रविण n. 1. Property, substance, wealth, Bh.V.iv.29; 2. gold, R.iv.70; 3. thing, matter, material; 4. strength, power; 5. valour.
द्रविण-अधिपति, -ईश्वर n. an epithet of Kubera.
द्रविण-अधिपति, -ईश्वर n. an epithet of Kubera.

द्रव्य n. 1. Substance, thing, object; 2. material to be worked upon; 3. elementary substance considered as one of the seven categories (in the Vaiśeṣika philosophy); (dravya is ninefold- पृथिव्यापस्तेजोवाय्वाकाशकालदिगात्ममनांसि T.S.); 4. possession, wealth, goods, money; 5. a fit object (to receive any impression &c. Cf. अद्रव्य); 6. bell-metal; 7. modesty; 8. spirituous liquor; 9. a stake, a wager.
द्रव्य-अर्जन n. acquisition of wealth.
द्रव्य-ओघ m. abundance of wealth.
द्रव्य-परिग्रह m. the possession of property or wealth.
द्रव्य-वत् a. rich, wealthy.
द्रव्य-वाचक n. a substantive.
द्रष्टव्य a. (f. व्या) 1. What ought to be seen; 2. pleasing to the sight, beautiful, द्रष्टव्येषु किमुत्तमम् Bhartr.i.8.
द्रष्टव्य a. (f. व्या) 1. What ought to be seen; 2. pleasing to the sight, beautiful, द्रष्टव्येषु किमुत्तमम् Bhartr.i.8.
द्रष्टृ m. 1. One who sees mentally, a seer, e.g. मंत्रद्रष्टृ; 2. a judge.
द्रह m. A deep lake.
द्रा vi. 2P (pp. द्राण; pres. द्राति) 1. To nin, to fly; 2. to sleep.With नि-, to sleep, नीरे नीरचरैः समं स भगवान्निद्राति नारायणः Bh.V.i.41, Na.i.121.With वि-, to run away, to retreat.
द्राक् ind. Quickly, instantly, immediately.
द्राग्भृतक n. water just drawn from a well.
द्राक्षा f. Vine, grape (either the creeper or the fruit), R.iv.65, Bh.V.i.14, iv.39.
द्राक्षा-रस m. grape-juicc, wine.
द्राघय् vt. (denom. pres. द्राघयति) To lengthen, to increase, to make intense, द्राघयंति हि मे शोकं स्मर्यमाणा गुणास्तव Bt.xviii.33.
द्राघिमन् m. 1. Length; 2. a degree of longitude.
द्राघिष्ठ a. (f. ष्ठा) Longest, (super. of दीर्घ q.v.).
द्राघिष्ठ a. (f. ष्ठा) Longest, (super. of दीर्घ q.v.).
द्राघीयस् a. (f. सी) Longer, (compar. of दीर्घ q.v.)
द्राघीयस् a. (f. सी) Longer, (compar. of दीर्घ q.v.)
द्राण (I) a. (f. णा) 1. Flown, run away; 2. sleeping, sleepy.
द्राण (II) n. 1. Running away, retreat; 2. sleep.
द्राण (I) a. (f. णा) 1. Flown, run away; 2. sleeping, sleepy.
द्राप m. 1. Mud, mire; 2. the sky; 3. a fool, an idiot; 4. an epithet of Śiva.
द्रामिल m. An epithet of Cāṇakya.
द्रावक (I) m. 1. A flux to assist diffusion of metals; 2. the moon-gem; 3. a thief; 4. a sharp or clever man, a wit; 5. a libertine, a lecher.
द्रावक (II) n. Wax.
द्रावण m. 1. Putting to flight; 2. fusing; 3. distilling; 4. the clearing-nut.
द्राविडक (I) m. Zedoary.
द्राविडक (II) n. Black salt.
द्राविडी f. Cardamoms.
